notes: Account: Seaforth Retrieval Hub — UK-headquartered fintech with heavy regulatory constraints (FS/PSD2 style data controls).
Primary ask: low-latency RAG search across product + transaction docs with EU/UK residency; multi-region routing + fast failover to UK zone.
Scale: initial index target 10M doc objects for POC, long-term plan 50-200M documents (topline estimate). Embedding store expected to be ~200-800M vectors depending on chunking.
Throughput/latency goals: 500 QPS burst, sustained 150 QPS; 95th P99 targets: 95p < 120ms (EU region), P99 < 350ms; reranking path must keep end-to-end < 250-400ms depending on rerank depth.
Cost sensitivity: engineering wants cost per query <= $0.005-0.01 for combined embed+rerank path; open to batching/quantization but need quality guardrails.

Model preference: open models (quantized Llama2/3 family or Mistral variants) for private deploy; will evaluate Redwood verified models. Must support 8-bit/4-bit quantization and pinning of model versions.
Security: strict SSO/SAML integration, KMS-managed keys for vector encryption at rest, audit logging for query/response retention, and contractual data residency for UK and EU customers.

Routing/fallback needs: primary EU region (eu-west) with automated routing to UK-region on regional outage; prefer policy-based routing by customer tenant and automatic fallback to smaller model variant when latency spike detected.
Interested in Redwood Optimize: want automated batching/caching recommendations and quantization profiles tied to utility metrics (precision@k, rerank NDCG).
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-28 call: 'We need predictable economics — the difference between $0.002 and $0.01 per query matters at our volumes.'
Existing infra: hybrid — main data in Azure UK/EU regions, legal insists no cross-border copies outside EU/UK. Customer open to Redwood Private (VPC) or on-prem package if required.
Competitive tension: internal POC with Elastic + custom MMR reranker; considering Redwood for better managed low-latency GPU serving and runbooked failover.
Operational asks: SLOs for 99.5% uptime, ability to trace token-level cost/latency in Console, and playbooks for capacity surge.

POC success criteria (agreed): index 10M docs, 95th latency <120ms for search-only, rerank end-to-end <300ms for 5 candidates, recall/rr@10 within 2% of baseline, cost per query at or below target with Optimize recommendations.
Action items: SE baseline tests, security questionnaire answers in drive doc, legal to review DPA + residency clause, schedule perf run w/ 10M sample set.
Notes style: short bullets, calls + quick paraphrases preserved for AE handoff.
